metadata.overview: Controls Proto R2 Rig bitcoin miners over the public firmware MDK HTTP API v1 with JWT bearer authentication. Operations affect physical hardware—prioritize thermal and power safety.

telemetry.name: hashrate_avg
telemetry.description: Average miner hashrate reported by the current telemetry endpoint.

telemetry.name: power
telemetry.description: Current miner power consumption.

telemetry.name: temperature
telemetry.description: Current aggregate miner temperature.

telemetry.name: efficiency
telemetry.description: Current miner energy efficiency. Firmware reports the equivalent J/TH value.

telemetry.name: status
telemetry.description: Mining state normalized to Tether MDK status values.

telemetry.name: uptime
telemetry.description: Elapsed time since system reboot in milliseconds.

telemetry.name: accepted_shares
telemetry.description: Total accepted shares across configured pools.

telemetry.name: rejected_shares
telemetry.description: Total rejected shares across configured pools.

telemetry.name: power_mode
telemetry.description: Current Tether MDK power mode: normal while operating and sleep while stopped or curtailed.

telemetry.name: power_target
telemetry.description: Configured mining power target in watts.

telemetry.name: fan_speed
telemetry.description: Average speed of all cooling fans.

telemetry.name: snap
telemetry.description: Structured miner statistics and non-secret configuration metadata.

telemetry.name: health
telemetry.description: Credential-safe device health: OK normally, DEGRADED for active firmware errors, or OFFLINE when status cannot be read.

telemetry.name: errors
telemetry.description: Active firmware errors as {name, code?, source?, slot?, timestamp?}. Empty array means no active errors. Only identifier-like codes are published; raw messages and undeclared fields are omitted.

telemetry.name: pools
telemetry.description: Configured pool URL, username, status and accepted/rejected share counts, with optional stale, id, priority, name and protocol. Stale shares stay absent when firmware does not report them. Passwords and authority keys are omitted; URLs with userinfo are rejected.

telemetry.name: hashboards
telemetry.description: Per-board index, optional serial_number, measured temperature_c {inlet, outlet, avg}, and optional hashrate_ths, power_w, efficiency_w_ths, voltage_v and current_a. Missing readings stay absent; inlet/outlet temperatures are not ASIC chip temperatures.

telemetry.name: device_info
telemetry.description: Device ID, product, manufacturer, model and serial number with optional non-secret network mode, IP, gateway, netmask, MAC and hostname. Missing or blank network strings stay absent; malformed present types and a missing network-info object remain errors. Independent of mining statistics; credentials and arbitrary firmware fields are omitted.

telemetry.name: firmware_info
telemetry.description: Reported OS version/build metadata and names/versions for mining driver, pool interface, web server, web dashboard and hashboard firmware. Missing components stay absent. Runtime OS status and free-form update messages are omitted.

telemetry.name: psu_info
telemetry.description: Power supply inventory as {psus: [...]}, with optional identity, slot, firmware versions, power readings in volts, amps and watts, and temperatures in Celsius. Missing fields stay absent; an empty psus array means no reported supplies. Credentials, free-form messages and undeclared fields are omitted.

telemetry.name: fans
telemetry.description: Measured cooling fans as {rpm, slot?, percentage?}. Percentage is an integer from 0 through 100; absent metadata stays absent. An empty array means no reported fans. Undeclared fields are omitted.

telemetry.name: pool_url
telemetry.description: URL of the Active pool, falling back to the first configured pool. An empty string means no pools are configured. URLs with userinfo are rejected; pool passwords are never published.

telemetry.name: asic_stats
telemetry.description: Current ASIC diagnostics as {hashboards: [{serial_number, slot?, board_type?, asic_type?, expected_asic_count?, status?, reported_asic_count?, asics?: [{index, id?, row?, column?, frequency_mhz?, temperature_c?, voltage_v?, hashrate_ths?, ideal_hashrate_ths?, error_rate_pct?}], error?}]}. Missing readings stay absent; no inferred health or history. Failed boards carry a stable error with no readings. One inventory read plus one status read per board, at most two board reads concurrently. Only overlapping pulls are shared; completed readings are never cached. Included in aggregate metrics; existing snap is unchanged.

commands.name: reboot
commands.constraints: A five-minute per-device cooldown is enforced after every attempt, including failures with unknown physical outcomes. Concurrent reboots are rejected. Do not retry after an unknown network outcome.

commands.name: setPowerMode
commands.constraints: Use normal to start mining or sleep to stop mining. Do not retry after an unknown network outcome.

commands.name: setPowerTarget
commands.description: Sets the R2 Rig mining power target in watts.
commands.constraints: Use a value within the device-reported minimum and maximum bounds. Concurrent target commands on one device are rejected with ERR_COMMAND_IN_PROGRESS. The echoed watts and known preserved settings must match; ERR_POWER_TARGET_WRITE_UNVERIFIED requires reading current device state. Verify cooling before increasing power. Do not retry after an unknown outcome.

commands.name: setPowerPreset
commands.description: Sets the mining watt target to the device-reported minimum or maximum, preserving the performance policy.
commands.constraints: preset is min or max. Bounds are read fresh for each command and must be positive safe integers within the R2 ceiling of 12000 W. Concurrent target commands on one device are rejected with ERR_COMMAND_IN_PROGRESS, including during the bounds read. The echoed watts and known preserved settings must match; ERR_POWER_TARGET_WRITE_UNVERIFIED requires reading current device state. Does not start or stop mining. Verify cooling before selecting max. Do not retry after an unknown outcome.

commands.name: setPerformanceMode
commands.description: Selects Proto's native performance policy. MaximumHashrate maximizes hashrate at the configured watt target; Efficiency optimizes J/TH at or below that target.
commands.constraints: mode is MaximumHashrate or Efficiency. Updates only performance_mode; the watt target and other target settings are preserved. Concurrent target commands on one device are rejected with ERR_COMMAND_IN_PROGRESS. The echoed performance_mode must match; ERR_POWER_TARGET_WRITE_UNVERIFIED requires reading current device state. Does not start or stop mining. Changing policy can change power consumption and heat. Do not retry after an unknown outcome.

commands.name: setLED
commands.description: Turns the control-board locate LED on or off.
commands.constraints: Use only for physical identification. Do not retry after an unknown network outcome.

commands.name: setupPools
commands.description: Replaces the configured mining pools with one to three entries. Required entry fields are non-empty url and worker_name strings; optional entry fields are worker_password and pool strings.
commands.constraints: The pools parameter must be an array containing one to three entries. URLs must include a hostname and omit userinfo. worker_password defaults to "" and pool defaults to "". appendId defaults to true and appends .<deviceId> to worker_name; false uses the bare worker name. Example pools: [{"url":"stratum+tcp://pool.example:3333","worker_name":"account.worker"}]. Preserve the previous configuration before changing mining destinations. Do not retry after an unknown network outcome.

commands.name: downloadLogs
commands.description: Returns a redacted firmware log tail as {source, lines, content}. This command reads logs without changing the device.
commands.constraints: source defaults to miner_sw and must be os, pool_sw, miner_sw or miner_web_server. lines defaults to 100 and must be an integer from 1 through 10000. Known device credentials, bearer tokens and recognized credential fields are redacted; review free-form logs before sharing.

commands.name: setNetwork
commands.description: Changes device networking using network: {dhcp, ip?, netmask?, gateway?, hostname?}. Returns {success: true} after a successful HTTP response.
commands.constraints: dhcp is a required boolean. Static mode requires IPv4 ip and a contiguous IPv4 netmask; gateway is optional IPv4. DHCP mode rejects ip, netmask and gateway. Optional hostname is one DNS label of 1 through 63 letters, digits or internal hyphens. Unknown fields are rejected. The device may change address or disconnect; preserve the previous settings and verify reachability independently. Do not retry after an unknown network outcome.

commands.name: updateFirmware
commands.description: Starts an OTA update when firmware is omitted, or uploads a firmware image. Returns {accepted: true, completed: false, mode: ota|upload}; acceptance does not confirm installation or reboot completion.
commands.constraints: Optional firmware must contain filename (a basename ending in .swu), encoding (base64), size (integer bytes from 1 through 536870912), sha256 (64 hexadecimal characters) and data (canonical base64). The declared size and hash are checked before I/O. The transport must accommodate base64 overhead and its own message limits. Credentials are renewed before the write when a password or refresh token is configured; access-token-only configurations use the existing token. Firmware requests never replay after 401 or ambiguous outcomes. Upload HTTP timeout is 30 minutes; allow sufficient caller time and verify firmware state before another attempt. Concurrent updates on one device are rejected. The overlap guard is process-local and does not deduplicate requests across restarts.

troubleshooting: If temperature is excessive, verify fan operation and ambient temperature before increasing the power target.
If status is error, inspect the firmware error source and slot before rebooting.
If status is offline, verify the address, password, HTTP port, and API reachability.

errors.ERR_DEVICE_ID_REQUIRED: The Tether MDK device ID is missing.
errors.ERR_COMMAND_COOLDOWN: A reboot was attempted within five minutes of the previous attempt, including an ambiguous failed attempt.
errors.ERR_COMMAND_IN_PROGRESS: A conflicting command is already running on this device.
errors.ERR_DEVICE_ADDRESS_INVALID: The device address must be a non-empty host-only string without userinfo, a port, path, query, or fragment.
errors.ERR_DEVICE_CREDENTIALS_REQUIRED: The device password or access token is missing.
errors.ERR_DEVICE_CREDENTIALS_INVALID: Configured password and token values must be non-empty strings.
errors.ERR_DEVICE_PORT_INVALID: The device port must be an integer from 1 through 65535.
errors.ERR_PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED: The configured protocol must be HTTP or HTTPS.
errors.ERR_FETCH_REQUIRED: No HTTP fetch implementation is available.
errors.ERR_HTTP_CLIENT_REQUIRED: The API adapter needs an HTTP client.
errors.ERR_API_CLIENT_REQUIRED: The worker-facing client needs an API adapter.
errors.ERR_CACHE_DURATION_INVALID: The read cache duration must be a finite number from zero through 5000 milliseconds.
errors.ERR_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_INVALID: The request timeout must be an integer from 1 through 2147483647 milliseconds.
errors.ERR_REQUEST_TIMEOUT: The firmware request exceeded the configured timeout.
errors.ERR_DEVICE_CONNECTION: The worker could not connect to the firmware API. A write may have an unknown physical outcome.
errors.ERR_HTTP_RESPONSE: The firmware returned a non-success HTTP status. A write may have an unknown physical outcome.
errors.ERR_RESPONSE_INVALID_JSON: The firmware returned malformed JSON. A write may have an unknown physical outcome.
errors.ERR_AUTHENTICATION_RESPONSE_INVALID: The authentication response did not contain valid token strings.
errors.ERR_SYSTEM_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware system response was malformed.
errors.ERR_NETWORK_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware network response was malformed.
errors.ERR_MINING_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware mining response was malformed.
errors.ERR_MINING_STATISTICS_UNAVAILABLE: The firmware has not produced mining statistics yet.
errors.ERR_POWER_TARGET_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware power-target response or safety bounds were malformed or unsafe.
errors.ERR_POWER_TARGET_WRITE_UNVERIFIED: The firmware target write returned a missing or contradictory target. The physical outcome is uncertain; read current device state before another write and do not retry automatically.
errors.ERR_TELEMETRY_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware telemetry response was malformed.
errors.ERR_COOLING_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware cooling response was malformed.
errors.ERR_ERRORS_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware errors response was malformed.
errors.ERR_POOLS_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware pools response was malformed or contained an unsafe URL.
errors.ERR_PSUS_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware power supply response was malformed.
errors.ERR_ASIC_STATS_RESPONSE_INVALID: Hashboard inventory or ASIC statistics were malformed or had conflicting identities.
errors.ERR_ASIC_STATS_UNAVAILABLE: A hashboard status request failed. Other boards remain readable; missing readings are not replaced with zero.
errors.ERR_LOGS_PARAMETERS_INVALID: Log source or line count is invalid.
errors.ERR_LOGS_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware log response was malformed or inconsistent with the request.
errors.ERR_NETWORK_CONFIG_INVALID: Network configuration must specify DHCP or valid static IPv4 settings and an optional hostname.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_PAYLOAD_INVALID: The firmware upload needs a safe .swu filename, canonical base64, matching size and SHA256.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_RESPONSE_INVALID: Firmware OTA must return HTTP 202 and firmware upload must return HTTP 200; verify the device before another attempt.
errors.ERR_POWER_TARGET_INVALID: The power target must normalize to a positive safe integer.
errors.ERR_POWER_PRESET_INVALID: The power preset must be min or max.
errors.ERR_PERFORMANCE_MODE_INVALID: The performance mode must be MaximumHashrate or Efficiency.
errors.ERR_POWER_TARGET_OUT_OF_RANGE: The power target is outside the bounds reported by the device.
errors.ERR_SET_POWER_MODE_INVALID: The power mode must be normal or sleep.
errors.ERR_SET_LED_ENABLED_INVALID: The LED value must be boolean.
errors.ERR_POOLS_INVALID: Pool configuration must contain one to three entries.
errors.ERR_POOL_ENTRY_INVALID: Each pool needs a safe URL without userinfo, a worker name, and valid optional strings.
errors.ERR_APPEND_ID_INVALID: The appendId pool option must be boolean.
